description: This file contains helper functions for loading and initializing Google Identity Services (GIS), including script loading, client initialization, button rendering, and prompting One Tap authentication.

methods.name: loadGisScript
methods.description: Loads the Google Identity Services script asynchronously and returns a promise that resolves when the script is loaded.

methods.name: initGis
methods.description: Initializes the Google Identity Services client with a specified client ID and callback, returning true if successful.

methods.name: renderGoogleButton
methods.description: Renders a Google Sign-In button into a specified DOM element with customizable options.

methods.name: promptOneTap
methods.description: Triggers the Google One Tap prompt if available.
